name: @parcha/tether
description: Configurable AI colleagues and Slack threads that continue exact Claude Code and Codex sessions through Hermes

scripts.test: npm run test:lint && python3 scripts/run_tests.py && python3 -m py_compile runtime/plugin_next/__init__.py runtime/plugin_next/active.py runtime/plugin_next/admission.py runtime/plugin_next/broker.py runtime/plugin_next/journal.py runtime/plugin_next/slack_egress.py runtime/plugin_next/store.py runtime/plugin_next/session_driver.py runtime/plugin_next/notices.py runtime/plugin_next/herdr.py runtime/plugin_next/team.py runtime/plugin_next/demo.py skills/tether/scripts/tether_notify.py && python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; assert "name: tether" in Path("runtime/plugin_next/plugin.yaml").read_text()' && python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool .codex-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool .agents/plugins/marketplace.json >/dev/null && node --check bin/tether.js && bash -n install.sh && bash tests/test_release_install.sh && bash tests/test_release_tarball.sh
scripts.test:release: python3 scripts/run_tests.py --pattern 'test_release_*.py' && node --check bin/tether.js && bash -n install.sh && bash tests/test_release_install.sh && bash tests/test_release_tarball.sh
scripts.lint: ruff check runtime skills/tether/scripts scripts tests && bandit -q -r runtime skills/tether/scripts scripts
scripts.test:lint: if command -v bandit >/dev/null; then bandit -q -r runtime skills/tether/scripts scripts; else echo 'bandit not installed; CI enforces it'; fi && if command -v ruff >/dev/null; then ruff check runtime skills/tether/scripts scripts tests; else echo 'ruff not installed; CI enforces it'; fi
